preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= n <= 2*10**5 for n in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of vertices n is between 2 and 2*10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(edges) == n-1 for n, edges in zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)], [input().split() for _ in range(sum([int(input().split()[0])-1 for _ in range(t)]))]))
preconditions.description: Each test case has exactly n-1 edges.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(edge[0]) <= n and 1 <= int(edge[1]) <= 10**9 and 1 <= int(edge[2]) <= 10**9 for n, edges in zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)], [input().split() for _ in range(sum([int(input().split()[0])-1 for _ in range(t)]))]) for edge in edges)
preconditions.description: For each edge in each test case, the ancestor p_j is between 1 and n inclusive, and both a_j and b_j are between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(len(result) == n-1 for n, result in zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)], [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(t)]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output contains exactly n-1 integers.

postconditions.expression: all(all(0 <= r_i <= n-1 for r_i in result) for n, result in zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)], [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(t)]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, each output integer r_i is between 0 and n-1 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(all(sum(int(edges[j][1]) for j in range(r_i)) >= sum(int(edges[j][2]) for j in range(r_i)) for r_i, edges in zip(result, [input().split() for _ in range(n-1)])) for n, result in zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)], [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(t)]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, for each vertex i, the sum of a_j along the prefix of length r_i of the path from the root to i is at least the sum of b_j along the same prefix.

postconditions.expression: all(all(sum(int(edges[j][1]) for j in range(r_i+1)) < sum(int(edges[j][2]) for j in range(r_i+1)) for r_i, edges in zip(result, [input().split() for _ in range(n-1)])) for n, result in zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)], [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(t)]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, for each vertex i, the sum of a_j along the prefix of length r_i + 1 of the path from the root to i is less than the sum of b_j along the same prefix.
